Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 096. 字符串交织

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool isInterleave(string s1, string s2, string s3) {
        int m = s1.size(), n = s2.size();
        if (m + n != s3.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        vector<vector<int>> f(m + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, -1));
        function<bool(int, int)> dfs = [&](int i, int j) {
            if (i >= m && j >= n) {
                return true;
            }
            if (f[i][j] != -1) {
                return f[i][j] == 1;
            }
            f[i][j] = 0;
            int k = i + j;
            if (i < m && s1[i] == s3[k] && dfs(i + 1, j)) {
                f[i][j] = 1;
            }
            if (!f[i][j] && j < n && s2[j] == s3[k] && dfs(i, j + 1)) {
                f[i][j] = 1;
            }
            return f[i][j] == 1;
        };
        return dfs(0, 0);
    }
};
